dialogues.jp: 「……ちょっといい？」
dialogues.en: "...Can I talk to you for a second?"
dialogues.text: "...Can I talk to you for a second?"

dialogues.jp: 机でぼんやりしていたことりに呼びかける。
dialogues.en:
I started speaking to Kotori, still sitting at her desk
absentmindedly.
dialogues.text:
I started speaking to Kotori, still sitting at her desk
absentmindedly.

dialogues.jp:
顔を上げたことりに、俺は、うっという｛うめ／呻｝きを
のどの奥で飲み込んだ。
dialogues.en:
She looked up at me. I swallowed down a moan of despair that
wanted to come out of my throat.
dialogues.text:
She looked up at me. I swallowed down a moan of despair that
wanted to come out of my throat.

dialogues.jp: （ほんとにひどい顔してるな……）
dialogues.en: "(She really looks horrible today...)"
dialogues.text: "(She really looks horrible today...)"

dialogues.jp:
血の気の欠けた青白い顔。目の下に浮かんだク
マ。覇気のない瞳……。
dialogues.en:
The blood and spirit had entirely left her pale face. Her
eyes had big white bags underneath like a panda.
dialogues.text:
The blood and spirit had entirely left her pale face. Her
eyes had big white bags underneath like a panda.

dialogues.jp:
何だか、ことりの顔のパーツを流用して作った、
出来の悪い模造品にさえ思えてきてしまう。
dialogues.en:
It's as if someone replaced some of Kotori's facial parts
with cheap knockoffs.
dialogues.text:
It's as if someone replaced some of Kotori's facial parts
with cheap knockoffs.

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「……なんですか？」
dialogues.en: "...What's up?"
dialogues.text: "...What's up?"

dialogues.jp:
笑みのような形を目元と口元に浮かべ、ことり
が首を傾げる。俺は、廊下に親指を向けた。
dialogues.en:
She forced a smile as she asked, tilting her head. I pointed
to the corridor with my thumb.
dialogues.text:
She forced a smile as she asked, tilting her head. I pointed
to the corridor with my thumb.

dialogues.jp: 「……ことり、今朝、鏡見た？」
dialogues.en: "...Kotori, did you check a mirror this morning?"
dialogues.text: "...Kotori, did you check a mirror this morning?"

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「……女の子ですから」
dialogues.en: "...I am a girl, of course I do."
dialogues.text: "...I am a girl, of course I do."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「ほんと、昨日からどうしたんだよ？　単なる
　体調？　それとも、悩みがあるとか？　今の
　ことり、ちょっと普通じゃないぜ？」
dialogues.en:
"Really, what happened yesterday? Were you just ill? Or do
you have some other issues? You're not your usual self right
now..."
dialogues.text:
"Really, what happened yesterday? Were you just ill? Or do
you have some other issues? You're not your usual self right
now..."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「その……心配なんだよ。だって、俺は……」
dialogues.en: "...I'm worried about you, Kotori... after all..."
dialogues.text: "...I'm worried about you, Kotori... after all..."

dialogues.jp: そこで声をひそめて、俺は言った。
dialogues.en: I paused for a second, then continued.
dialogues.text: I paused for a second, then continued.

dialogues.jp: 「ことりの恋人なんだからさ」
dialogues.en: "I'm your lover after all."
dialogues.text: "I'm your lover after all."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「……本当ですか？」
dialogues.en: "...Really?"
dialogues.text: "...Really?"

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「当たり前だろう。どこの世界に、心配しない
　奴が──」
dialogues.en:
"Of course I am. A boyfriend who wouldn't be worried would
be--"
dialogues.text:
"Of course I am. A boyfriend who wouldn't be worried would
be--"

dialogues.jp:
言いかけた言葉が、鼻先でドアを閉じられる。
ドアとは、ことりの動作だ。
dialogues.en:
As I talked, the door in front of us was closed shut. Kotori
had closed it.
dialogues.text:
As I talked, the door in front of us was closed shut. Kotori
had closed it.

dialogues.jp:
ことりは首を振っている。そうしながら、彼女
は言った。
dialogues.en: Kotori then shook her head, and started speaking.
dialogues.text: Kotori then shook her head, and started speaking.

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「そっちじゃなくて……」
dialogues.en: "That's not what I meant..."
dialogues.text: "That's not what I meant..."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.en: "......? Then what did you mean?"
dialogues.text: "......? Then what did you mean?"

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「……ごめんなさい。何でもないんです……」
dialogues.en: "...I'm sorry, just forget about it..."
dialogues.text: "...I'm sorry, just forget about it..."

dialogues.jp:
一体、どうした事だろう？　ことりの様子も変
だが、俺に対する態度も変だ。
dialogues.en:
What on earth is happening? Her appearance is weird, and her
attitude and behaviour is differnt as well.
dialogues.text:
What on earth is happening? Her appearance is weird, and her
attitude and behaviour is differnt as well.

dialogues.jp:
妙に奥歯に物の挟まったような喋り方。付き合
う以前のような“ですます”調。
dialogues.en:
She was struggling to even get anything out of her throat. I
half-expected her to start calling me "sir".
dialogues.text:
She was struggling to even get anything out of her throat. I
half-expected her to start calling me "sir".

dialogues.jp: 壁を感じてしまう。
dialogues.en: It was really like talking to a wall.
dialogues.text: It was really like talking to a wall.

dialogues.jp:
すぐそこにことりは見えるのに。手を伸ばせば
届くはずなのに。
dialogues.en:
That was the Kotori in front of me right now. I couldn't
reach her with my hands.
dialogues.text:
That was the Kotori in front of me right now. I couldn't
reach her with my hands.

dialogues.jp: ことりが見えない。
dialogues.en: I couldn't see her.
dialogues.text: I couldn't see her.

dialogues.jp: ことりに触れられない。
dialogues.en: I couldn't feel her.
dialogues.text: I couldn't feel her.

dialogues.jp: そんな気がした。
dialogues.en: That was all I could think of.
dialogues.text: That was all I could think of.

dialogues.jp: キ〜ンコ〜ンカ〜ンコ〜ン。
dialogues.en: --*ding dong ding dong*
dialogues.text: --*ding dong ding dong*

dialogues.jp:
チャイムが鳴った途端、ことりは教室に入って
いってしまった。まるで、居心地の悪い時間か
ら逃げ出すように……。
dialogues.en:
As soon as the chime went off, Kotori returned to the
classroom. The conversation was obviously making her
uncomfortable...
dialogues.text:
As soon as the chime went off, Kotori returned to the
classroom. The conversation was obviously making her
uncomfortable...

dialogues.jp: 喧嘩したわけでもないのに……。
dialogues.en: We haven't quarelled or anything...
dialogues.text: We haven't quarelled or anything...

dialogues.jp:
俺が気づいていないだけで、ことりが傷つくよ
うなことを、俺は言っていたのかも知れない。
dialogues.en:
As I thought about it, I could've easily said something that
hurt her without realizing it.
dialogues.text:
As I thought about it, I could've easily said something that
hurt her without realizing it.

dialogues.jp:
それが深くことりの心を傷つけて、あんな風に
してしまったのかも知れない。
dialogues.en: Even something then seems to have affected her so deeply.
dialogues.text: Even something then seems to have affected her so deeply.

dialogues.jp: だって──。
dialogues.en: Because--
dialogues.text: Because--

dialogues.jp:
俺とことりは、それほどお互いに強く惹かれ合っ
ていたんだから。
dialogues.en: Kotori and I love each other. A whole lot.
dialogues.text: Kotori and I love each other. A whole lot.

dialogues.jp: 相手を慈しめば、どれだけ心が癒されたか。
dialogues.en: The feelings of love bind our hearts as well.
dialogues.text: The feelings of love bind our hearts as well.

dialogues.jp: その癒しが大きければ大きいほど……。
dialogues.en: The bind is bing and strong...
dialogues.text: The bind is bing and strong...

dialogues.jp:
相手を傷つけた時、どれほど深い傷になってし
まうんだろう？
dialogues.en:
So the only one who could hurt her this badly... would be
the one she's with?
dialogues.text:
So the only one who could hurt her this badly... would be
the one she's with?

dialogues.jp: 「俺の……せいだ」
dialogues.en: "It's... my fault."
dialogues.text: "It's... my fault."

dialogues.jp: ◆疑惑◆
dialogues.en: ◆Doubt◆
dialogues.text: ◆Doubt◆

dialogues.jp:
ことりは本当にどうしたのだろう？　気になっ
た俺は、廊下の片隅に彼女を連れていった。
dialogues.en:
What's really up with Kotori? Worried, I called her over to
a corner of the corridot to talk.
dialogues.text:
What's really up with Kotori? Worried, I called her over to
a corner of the corridot to talk.

dialogues.jp:
しかしことりは何も語ってくれない。それどこ
ろか、どこか俺を避けている風でもある。
dialogues.en:
But Kotori didn't want to, and ran away at the first
possible opportunity.
dialogues.text:
But Kotori didn't want to, and ran away at the first
possible opportunity.

dialogues.jp: ──どうして……？
